query: delete from iceberg_mirror.data_file df where df.table_id = $1 and df.end_snapshot is not null and df.end_snapshot <= $2 and ($3::bigint is null or ( select cs.max_value from iceberg_mirror.data_file_column_stat cs where cs.data_file_id = df.data_file_id and cs.column_name = 'loom_offset')::bigint < $3::bigint)
